full_judgment: 2. The prosecution case, in short, is that accused appellant Md. Sirajuddin Sheikh and his brother co-accused Abul Mansur Sheikh on 25,5.91 filed a case before the Additional Deputy Commissioner (Rev.), Gazipur for mutation in their names land measuring 37.90 acres appertaining to the Government khas khatian of Mouza Pelayet, Police Station Sreepur, District Gazipur, on the basis of a decree allegedly passed in their favour in Title Suit No. 72 of 1988 passed by the Court of the Subordinate Judge, Gazipur wherein their title was declared. The application for mutation created suspicion in the mind of the Revenue Officer who enquired into the matter personally in the office of the Subordinate Judge, Gazipur and came to learn that the aforesaid Title Suit No. 72 of 1988 of the Court of the Subordinate Judge, Gazipur was dismissed on 27.11.90 on contest against the plaintiffs and their claim of a decree in that suit was totally false and fraudulent. Thereafter the Assistant Commissioner of Land at Gazipur lodged a complainant at Gazipur Police Station against the accused appellant and his brother Abul Hossain Sheikh for creating a false and fictitious certified copy of the judgment in respect of Title Suit No. 72 of 1988 of the Court of the Subordinate Judge. Gazipur and use the said false and forged certified copy in the mutation proceedings before the Revenue Officer, Gazipur. The report of the Revenue Officer containing the aforesaid allegations has been treated as the FIR in the case and marked as Ext. 14.
